answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one sparrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 118 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 210 times the capital for one share. The whisper report publishes the merge explicitly at each falcon. Each duplicate costs another 182 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
